name: Trailmaster Waterproof Shell Jacket
description: Lightweight 3-layer waterproof shell jacket designed for harsh trail conditions. Features fully taped seams, adjustable hood, and pit-zip vents. Ideal for hiking and mountaineering in wet weather.

name: Alpine Base Camp Sleeping Bag
description: Three-season sleeping bag rated to 20°F. Down-filled with a mummy cut for warmth retention. Includes compression sack and interior pocket for valuables.

name: UltraLight Trekking Tent
description: Freestanding two-person backpacking tent weighing under 1.5kg. Double-wall construction with mesh inner for ventilation and waterproof fly. Sets up in under 5 minutes.

name: Compact Water Filtration System
description: Personal squeeze-style water filter that removes 99.9999% of bacteria and protozoa. Filters up to 100,000 gallons. Lightweight and essential for backcountry trips.

name: Bear Canister Food Container
description: Bear-resistant hard-sided food canister approved by national parks. Holds 4-5 days of food. Smooth exterior prevents bears from gripping. Required in many wilderness areas.

name: Collapsible Trekking Poles
description: Aluminum folding trekking poles with cork grips and tungsten carbide tips. Three-section fold collapses to 38cm. Adjustable height 100-130cm. Great for steep descents and river crossings.

name: Merino Wool Base Layer Top
description: 195gsm merino wool crew-neck base layer. Naturally odor-resistant and temperature-regulating. Soft enough to wear against skin on multi-day trips. Machine washable.

name: Insulated Puffer Vest
description: 600-fill power down vest with quilted shell. Lightweight mid-layer for cool mornings and high-output activities. Two hand pockets and one interior chest pocket. Packable into its own pocket.

name: Softshell Climbing Pants
description: Stretchy 4-way softshell pants built for climbing and scrambling. Articulated knees and gusseted crotch for full range of motion. Water-repellent finish handles light rain.

name: Sun Hoody UPF 50 Shirt
description: Lightweight long-sleeve sun hoody with UPF 50+ protection. Quick-dry fabric wicks moisture. Thumbholes keep sleeves in place. Ideal for desert hiking and kayaking.

name: Fleece Midlayer Pullover
description: 300-weight recycled polyester fleece pullover with half-zip. Exceptionally warm for its weight. Ideal as a standalone layer in cool weather or mid-layer under a shell.

name: Rain Pants Lightweight
description: Packable waterproof rain pants with full-length side zips for easy on/off over boots. 2.5-layer construction balances waterproofing and breathability. Stuff into its own pocket.

name: Waterproof Hiking Boot Mid
description: Mid-cut waterproof leather hiking boot with aggressive lug sole. Gore-Tex lining keeps feet dry. Vibram outsole provides grip on wet rock and loose trail. Break-in period is minimal.

name: Trail Running Shoe
description: Responsive trail runner with rock plate and aggressive traction lugs. Breathable mesh upper with TPU overlays for durability. Suitable for technical terrain and ultra-distance running.

name: Camp Sandal with Arch Support
description: Adjustable camp sandal with contoured footbed and arch support. EVA midsole cushions tired feet after a long day on trail. Quick-dry webbing straps. Doubles as a water shoe.

name: Mountaineering Boot Double
description: Insulated double mountaineering boot compatible with step-in crampons. Rated to -40°C. Plastic outer shell with removable insulated inner boot. For glacier travel and high-altitude climbing.

name: Approach Shoe Sticky Rubber
description: Low-cut approach shoe bridging hiking and climbing. Sticky rubber toe rand for scrambling. Precise fit for edging on rock. Comfortable enough for long walk-ins to crags.

name: 40L Daypack Ventilated
description: 40-liter ventilated daypack with suspended mesh back panel. Internal frame transfers weight to hip belt. Hydration compatible, integrated rain cover, and laptop sleeve. Ideal for day hikes and overnight trips.

name: 65L Expedition Backpack
description: Full-featured 65-liter expedition pack with fit-on-the-fly hip belt and load-lifter straps. Top lid converts to a summit pack. Compression straps keep load stable. For multi-day and week-long expeditions.

name: Backpacking Stove Canister
description: Ultra-compact canister stove that boils 1L water in 3.5 minutes. Folds to fist size. Works with all Lindal-valve canisters. Includes piezo ignition. Weighs 73g without canister.

name: Titanium Cookset 2-Person
description: Lightweight titanium 2-person cookset with 1.6L pot, 0.8L pot, and two lids that double as frying pans. Nests compactly. Titanium construction resists corrosion and is scratch-resistant.

name: Headlamp 400 Lumen Rechargeable
description: 400-lumen rechargeable headlamp with red night-vision mode. IPX6 waterproof rated. USB-C charging. Beam distance 80m. Lightweight at 86g. Lock mode prevents accidental activation in pack.

name: Navigation GPS Handheld
description: Rugged handheld GPS with 3-inch sunlight-readable display. Preloaded topographic maps. 24-hour battery life. Tracks waypoints, routes, and breadcrumb trails. IPX7 waterproof.

name: Merino Wool Beanie
description: Fine-knit 100% merino wool beanie. Naturally warm without bulk. Odor-resistant for multi-day wear. Fits under a helmet. Ribbed cuff folds up for a relaxed fit.

name: Sun Hat Wide Brim UPF 50
description: Wide-brim hiking hat with UPF 50+ protection and moisture-wicking sweatband. Crushable brim springs back to shape. Chin strap keeps it on in wind. Vented crown for breathability.

name: Lightweight Gloves Touchscreen
description: Thin merino-lined softshell gloves with touchscreen-compatible fingertips. Windproof and water-resistant. Fits under heavier glove shells as a liner. Elastic cuff keeps debris out.

name: Trekking Gaiters Low
description: Low-cut trail gaiters that keep debris, snow, and mud out of trail shoes and low boots. Hook-and-loop closure with instep strap. Abrasion-resistant front panel. Fits most trail footwear.

name: Emergency Bivvy Survival Bag
description: Reflective mylar emergency bivvy bag that retains 90% of body heat. Fits in a shirt pocket. Waterproof and windproof. Essential safety item for any day hiker or mountaineer.

name: Trekking Gaiters High Waterproof
description: Full-height waterproof gaiters for deep snow, mud, and stream crossings. CORDURA shell with Gore-Tex waterproof lining. Front zip with hook closure. Compatible with crampon-ready boots.

name: Trekking Pole Basket Set
description: Replacement basket set for trekking poles including two snow baskets and two mud baskets. Universal fit for poles with standard 8mm tip thread. Lightweight at 18g per pair.
